description: This Java class represents pagination data, encapsulating properties such as page size, current page, offset, total count, and total pages. It provides methods to retrieve pagination information, navigate to next and previous pages, and manage pagination state.

classes.name: PaginationData
classes.description: A POJO class that models pagination details for use in web shop views, including logic for calculating offsets, total pages, and navigating pages.

methods.name: PaginationData
methods.description: Constructor initializing page size and current page, with validation against zero page size.

methods.name: getPageSize
methods.description: Returns the number of results per page.

methods.name: getPageNumber
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current page number based on the offset and page size.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Calculates and returns the offset index for results retrieval.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns a new PaginationData object representing the next page.

methods.name: getPrevious
methods.description: Returns a new PaginationData object representing the previous page.

methods.name: getTotalCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of items.

methods.name: setTotalCount
methods.description: Sets the total count of items.

methods.name: getTotalPages
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total number of pages.
